g.text: 8192-token prefix · 512-token suffix · 128 outputs · 1 warmup excluded + 3 measured per branch

Resident Python COW API · RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, GPU 0 · same Q4_K_XL model, policy, schedule, tokens, and sampled frontiers (A/B exact match). Each request includes 512 suffix-prefill tokens; saved prefix is not replayed and no disk bytes are loaded. Model startup
and checkpoint write are outside the timed request.
